assumptions: García table rows are source-specific empirical operating points, not fitted channel physics.
A factor of seven is an explicit per-channel-flow scenario, not an accepted correction. Axial loss stays fixed while module flow scales.
Scale source and process membrane areas by parallel replication at unchanged per-element axial loss; fractional equivalent module count is a normalization.
Chiu figure constraint assumes nondecreasing critical flux and uses reading intervals to bracket, without interpolation through the transition or extrapolation.
Capacity fractions 1.0 and 0.8 are operating-policy scenarios; 0.8 is not a measured safety factor.
Source temperature and viscosity are unavailable. DWSIM uses the preserved 298.15 K pure-water property anchor, a conditional dilute-carrier approximation.
Passive-solute bookkeeping assumes rejection 1 and fixes module-inlet concentration by adjusting fresh concentration; no particle species or fouling law is implemented in DWSIM.

The original OpenLB-derived support resistance and fixed non-support impedance supply TMP. Crossflow criteria are common to the three support designs; no geometry-dependent fouling benefit is inferred.
Separate fresh-feed and circulation pumps retain the previous lumped upstream pressure-loss topology, with no resolved axial TMP field.
Lowest energy means lowest among solved admissible discrete points under a named policy, never a continuous or validated plant optimum.
